**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

§ 22 (Audit Rights) is the only audit/verification right binding us, and it lands squarely at the playbook's *preferred* position on every material term:

- **Frequency** — no more than once in any twelve-month period (22.1)
- **Notice** — at least thirty days' prior written notice (22.1)
- **Conduct** — normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1)
- **Cost** — Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2)
- **System access** — expressly barred, along with unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and other suppliers' confidential information (22.2)

§ 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no operative Vendor audit right, and a document-wide search found no remote-monitoring, telemetry or unannounced-inspection language that could reopen the walk-away risk. § 22.3 is further protection in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and shortfall payment resolves the audited quantity absent fraud or demonstrable error) — nothing to flag.
